name: Seek guidance for starting and operating specific businesses
description: Users sought practical advice, legal guidance, and operational steps for launching and running specific types of businesses, ranging from retail and agriculture to digital services and industrial trades. While some queries explored general feasibility or financing options, the dominant focus was on the concrete requirements, structures, and initial processes necessary to establish a venture.
